subject: Recompose this image as an aerial drone perspective: shift the camera viewpoint to a steep downward angle (60 to 90 degrees from horizontal), recreate the subject from this high-angle or near-top-down perspective while preserving all identity, proportions, colors, clothing, and scene details. Render appropriate foreshortening and aerial depth compression. The result should look like a natural drone shot from 100 to 200 meters altitude — expansive, geometric, slightly abstract.
